forms.title: Workable hosted application (apply.workable.com/<account>/j/<shortcode>/apply/)
quirks: data-ui hooks on every field wrapper; ids follow Workable's form API (firstname, lastname, headline, address, avatar, QA_<id>, CA_<id>)
phone input with flag/dial-code country dropdown defaulting to United States; a typed +<code> switches country; value sent as E.164
Education and Experience '+ Add' open inline sub-forms that must be saved into cards (MM/YYYY masks, 'I currently work here' disables End date)
resume drop zone 'Upload a file or drag and drop here' over a hidden file input
cover letter as a textarea, not a file
Yes/No question as a radio group sending true/false
custom listbox dropdown (CA_18811) whose values are option ids and whose labels carry leading spaces (' 2 weeks')
inline 'This field is required' errors with aria-invalid and a summary banner; unsaved sub-form blocks submit
multipart FormData via XMLHttpRequest, success panel, then redirect
forms.reference: Workable public form definitions (apply.workable.com/api/v1/jobs/<shortcode>/form) for hosted job pages, plus the hosted apply page layout
